about: Golden cases for instruction-based editing (docs/instruction_editing_plan.md §5). Shared by the iOS EditApplier tests and the proxy's JS reference applier. Each case runs its tool calls through decode -> validate -> apply against the fixture. expect.style lists the style keys that change (all others must be unchanged); expect.captions is the full resulting caption list (a string is the text only; an object can also pin start/end, emphasis (null = none) and words [text, start, end]), "repaced" when pacing rebuilds the lines, and omitted when captions must be unchanged. fixture_style overrides style keys of the fixture for one case.
